how: Extracted by scripts/gate_shards.py::parse_failures from the six shard logs of the 2026-09-09 six-shard run at 0ffe68a14 (1181 files). That run predates the committed wrapper and is NOT of record for a pass/fail verdict, but its logs are a faithful capture.
provenance_caveat: SEEDED FROM A RUN ON THE BRANCH, NOT THE BRANCH BASE. If the hub had introduced a failure it would have been baked in here. The per-TEST identities are new here and are not corroborated by that earlier measurement. Re-measure at the branch base to remove this caveat.
